description: Create a new WordPress user. Returns { id, username, created }; the password is never echoed.

password.description: Write-only password, never echoed (a strong one is generated if omitted). The endpoint sanitizes it as text: tags, %XX sequences and surrounding whitespace are stripped, so avoid them.

send_notification.description: Send the new-user email with a set-password link (default true)

name: mcp_create_user
